LanguageData.Rimverse_AsyncExpedition: The {0} ask for a crew to cross the endless rooms on their behalf. Send a colonist into the rooms within fifteen days and bring them back to be paid.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AsyncExpeditionDone: {0} came back from the rooms with the maps the asynchronous travelers wanted. They paid well.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AsyncExpeditionFailed: The asynchronous expedition expired. Nobody went into the rooms in time.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AsyncRescue: You found {0} in the rooms. They are grateful, and so are their people.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AsyncRescueAsk: {0}, a researcher from the asynchronous travelers, was swallowed by the rooms right next to your ship. Go in after them and they will join you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_BodyEccentric: Eccentric orbit ({0}): seasons swing hard between near and far.
LanguageData.Rimverse_BodyTidalLocked: Tidally locked: one side always faces the star.
LanguageData.Rimverse_BulkheadSealed: A bulkhead sealed itself to stop the air from escaping.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CivPreSpace: A pre-space civilization: it cannot leave its world yet.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdMovePrisonerDesc: Send this prisoner by shuttle to another of your ships or stations in the same star system. They go to a free prisoner bed if there is one.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdMovePrisonerNone: No other ship or station of yours is in this star system, or a ship is traveling.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatAlliesGoodwill: Allies mods: spent goodwill changes civilization opinion
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatAlliesGoodwill_Desc: With Allies are Helpful, Guards For Me or Raids For Me, the goodwill you spend asking a Rimverse civilization for help also lowers that civilization's opinion of you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatAnomalyExtras_Desc: Entities from Anomaly mods survive vacuum like the base entities. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatNoForcedSlowdown: No Forced Slowdown: no threat auto-pause while a ship travels
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatNoForcedSlowdown_Desc: While one of your ships is traveling, the Rimverse pause on threats does not trigger. Off by default.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatPsycasts: Psycast mods: faster psyfocus for Flow-sensitive pawns
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatPsycasts_Desc: Flow-sensitive pawns regain psyfocus 10% faster. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatRealisticRooms: Realistic Rooms: lower crowded ship threshold
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatRealisticRooms_Desc: A ship counts as crowded below 10 cells per crew member instead of 16. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatRimmuNation: Rimmu-Nation clothing: hazmat gear seals a little
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatRimmuNation_Desc: Gas masks and hazmat gear from Rimmu-Nation clothing give a small vacuum seal (+10%). Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatShipVersions: Ship mods: storage and hydroponics count as ship parts
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatShipVersions_Desc: Storage and hydroponics buildings from ship mods count as cargo and hydroponics on Rimverse ships. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatTweaksHeader: Adjustments for other mods (greyed out when the mod is not active; the ones that change items need a restart):
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatWeapons: Weapon mods: heavy rounds can breach the hull
LanguageData.Rimverse_CompatWeapons_Desc: Heavy and explosive rounds from weapon mods can breach the hull, like Rimverse weapons. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ContractNone: No contract fits your situation right now.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ContractSmuggleCaught: {0} caught the smuggled cargo. The contract failed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ContractSpyCaught: {0} caught your spies. The contract failed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicRegion: Region of the web: a looser grouping of clusters between walls.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicWebCounts: {0} voids, {1} walls, {2} superclusters and {3} regions in this chunk.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DesNoTurretFireDesc: Mark cells where your turrets never shoot at anything.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowAwakenDanger: Close to death, {0} felt the Great Flow wake inside.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowAwakenMaster: Near a master of the Flow, {0} woke to the Great Flow.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowAwakenMeditation: Meditating beside the crystal, {0} woke to the Great Flow.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowLevelUp: {0} reached level {1} in the Great Flow.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowNoApprentice: No Flow user here can be taught.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowNotSensitive: {PAWN_nameDef} does not feel the Great Flow.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowTakeApprenticeDesc: Teach a less experienced Flow user. An apprentice near their master learns three times faster. A master has one apprentice at a time.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowVisionDone: {0} opened their mind to the whole system. Every body here is revealed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowWandererText: A wanderer of the Great Flow passed by and shared their teachings with {0}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ImpossibleMap: A map arrived that should not exist: a door drawn into a ship near {0}. Take the ship there and the door will be waiting.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterBombard: {0} claims the system of {1} and sent a fleet to bombard the colony.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterLegitimacy: The government of {0} lost all legitimacy and was replaced by: {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterNemesis: The {0} is back. {1} commands it again, after escaping you {2} time(s).
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterSiege:
The fleet of {0} did not leave after its attack. It has taken orbit and is besieging this system for about {1} days.
While the siege lasts, no orbital trader can reach you, trade routes through the system are cut, and the fleet may strike again any day. Park a fleet of your own here, stronger than theirs, to break the siege, or make peace.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterSiegeBroken: Your fleet broke the siege. The fleet of {0} withdrew with heavy losses.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterSiegeLifted: The fleet of {0} lifted the siege and is going home.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterTechRevolution: {0} went through a technological revolution and reached the {1} age. Its new government: {2}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterTradeWar: {0} sees {1} as a competitor and declared a trade embargo for 20 days.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgEmbargoed: {0} has an embargo against you and will not trade.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgFreighterHere: A {1} of {0} arrived in this system and is open for trade.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgFreighterRaided: Pirates raided a freighter of {0} near {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgSensorsEvaded: The sensors on {0} spotted the ambush early. The ship slipped away before it closed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfBackground_Desc: Draw the star sky, planets and sun behind space maps. Turning it off saves the most.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfCityHorizon_Desc: On civilization city maps, show the rest of the city continuing past the edge of the map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfMegastructures_Desc: Draw rings, swarms, habitats and gates in the background.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfPauseMaps_Desc: Maps you are not looking at, with none of your people on them and that are not your home, stop ticking until someone arrives. Saves a lot with many stations and derelicts open.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfStars_Desc: How many stars the background draws.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfStreaks_Desc: Draw moving star streaks while the ship travels.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PerfTraffic_Desc: Draw stations and moving ships around inhabited worlds, busiest around a civilization's seat.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PlagueSpread: {0} caught the alien plague from {1}. Keep the sick in a room with a quarantine chamber.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolAutoResearch: Researchers chose a new project by themselves: {0}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolDaysToRotDesc: How many days this item lasts at the current temperature.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolFollowDesc: Keep the camera on this colonist until you turn it off.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolInstantCaravanDesc: The map is safe: the caravan forms and leaves at once, without packing.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolLinkPlantersDesc: Copy this plant to every connected planter of the same kind.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolLinkPlantersDone: {0} planters now grow the same plant.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolQuickStockpileDesc: Turn every free cell of this room into a stockpile.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolQuickStockpileNoRoom: This module is not inside a closed room.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolRemoteStockDesc: See what the traders of this settlement sell right now.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolRenameDesc: Give this building a name of your choice.
LanguageData.Rimverse_QolTreatFirstDesc: Doctors treat this colonist before anyone else.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RareFind: The sensors locked onto {0}, a size class {1} object. Things this large are found once in a lifetime. The data alone is worth a fortune, and the research team is already busy.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RetrofitDoneText: {0} cells of gravship substructure are now Rimverse hull. Install the delivered bridge on the ship to command it as a Rimverse vessel. The grav engine still works.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RetrofitNoGravship: There is no gravship substructure on this map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsDoor: A yellow door has appeared in a wall of the ship. It was not there before, and whoever walks through it will end up in the endless rooms.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsDoorLabel: Door that should not be here
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsReturnedCoords: {0} came back from the rooms remembering the exact coordinates of {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsStowaway: Something followed your colonist back from the rooms and has been hiding aboard. It just came out.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsStrayFound: {0} has been waiting here since the rooms spat them out. They are back aboard.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsWreck: {0} found pieces of a wrecked ship scattered in the rooms.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RoomsWrongReturn: {0} stepped out of the rooms in the wrong place, somewhere near {1}. Take the ship there to pick them up.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RuinResearch: The precursor ruins advanced the rare research {0}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SensorVisorNothing: The visor finds nothing to measure.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SensorVisorScanDesc: Read the size class of the star system and every body in it.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_SignatureAdd_Desc: While running, this part makes the ship easier to detect. Each parked vehicle also adds 2%.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SuitUpOnBreach: Hull breach: {0} colonists are putting on vacuum suits.

LanguageData.Rimverse_TechSaleOpinion: they do not trust you enough
LanguageData.Rimverse_TechStolen: Your spies brought back data on {0} from {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_VisibilityThreat: Your heat, power, jumps and fame lit you up across the region. Someone came looking.
LanguageData.Rimverse_VisibilityTotal: Visibility in the region: {0} points (warnings at 400,000 and 600,000, trouble at 800,000)
LanguageData.Rimverse_VisibilityWarn1: Your signature reached {0} points. Pirates and hunters are starting to notice you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_VisibilityWarn2: Your signature reached {0} points. You are easy to find now; expect company soon.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WeaponCharge: Cell charge: {0}/{1} shots. Recharges near powered equipment.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WeaponOverheat: {0} carried by {1} overheated and must vent before firing again.
